# Fully pinned, hash-verified dependency closure of cffconvert 2.0.0 for the
# "Validate CITATION.cff" workflow (pip install --require-hashes).
#
# cffconvert 2.0.0 is the latest release that validates CITATION.cff against
# the CFF 1.2.0 schema bundled with it. Its runtime dependencies (and their
# transitive dependencies) are pinned here because pip hash-checking mode
# requires a hash for every package it installs.
#
# Each line pins a distribution by an exact version and the sha256 digest of
# the file that pip selects when resolving natively on the workflow's target
# platform (ubuntu-latest: CPython 3.12, glibc, x86_64). The digests were
# computed from the files downloaded by `pip download` on that platform, so
# they are guaranteed to match the wheels pip actually installs in CI. Note
# that pip normalizes dashes in wheel filenames to underscores and chooses the
# best-matching wheel for the target; hashes here are for those exact files.
# docopt 0.6.2 publishes no wheel, so its sdist is pinned and built instead.
#
# When updating, pin every package with ==, keep the hashes in sync with PyPI
# (regenerate this file on a Linux/CPython 3.12 host), and make sure every
# version constraint of every package remains satisfied.
#
# setuptools is pinned to 84.0.0 (not the minimum jsonschema allows) because
# all older releases are affected by one or more published GitHub advisories:
# GHSA-cx63-2mw6-8hw5 (fixed >=70.0.0), GHSA-5rjg-fvgr-3xxf (fixed >=78.1.1)
# and GHSA-h35f-9h28-mq5c (fixed >=83.0.0).
